validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" initial="work">
  <state id="work" initial="p">
    <parallel id="p"/>
    <transition event="go" target="done"/>
  </state>
  <final id="done"/>
</scxml>

primary.message: no transition is enabled through this state

notes: SCXML 1.0 §3.4.2 allows a `<parallel>` with no `<state>` children, but only atomic states enable transitions (§3.13: "enabled by named event E in atomic state S"), and a `<parallel>` is never atomic (§3.3: "An atomic state is a <state> that has no <state>, <parallel> or <final> children"); while it is active, its own transitions are never taken, its ancestors' only through other active atomic states, and it never raises `done.state`
diagnostics.help: give the `<parallel>` its regions as child `<state>` elements, or make it an atomic `<state>`
